claims.text: ANRI describes Batavia’s Company council and mediated diplomatic correspondence. Ginaris’s institutional-hosted synthesis describes a Mataram-appointed Surabaya prince with VOC approval before 1743 and later Company control. These are different relations, not one timeless institution. The synthesis is not an inspected treaty, and Batavia records do not establish every Surabaya practice.
